Q1: Which host-side Claude review roles should this issue move into the network-isolated sandbox and relay path?
Choices:
A) Only `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR` (`scripts/review_consolidate.sh:617`), exactly as the finding states. `RB_JUDGE` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVER` stay exposed until a separate audit finding covers them.
B) All three roles that run on PR-derived input: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR`, `RB_JUDGE`, and `CONFLICT_RESOLVER`. They all reuse the `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh` / `claude_anthropic_relay.py` pattern, so no review role keeps the token in reach of a Bash-capable model. (RECOMMENDED)
C) `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR` in this issue, plus separate follow-up issues for `RB_JUDGE` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVER`. The conflict resolver also needs its merge-index handling carried into the sandbox, so it may be worth splitting off.
